# Greater Boston

[All metro areas](../data-sources.md)

**Covers:** Boston and its suburbs, the North Shore, the South Shore, Worcester County, Bristol County, Cape Cod, Martha's Vineyard and Nantucket in Massachusetts, Rhode Island, southern New Hampshire, and the edge of York County, Maine, from Berwick to Kittery. The title bar shows which of these parts a place is in: Boston, North Shore, South Shore, Central Massachusetts, Bristol County, MA, Cape Cod, Dukes County, MA, Nantucket County, MA, Rhode Island, New Hampshire or York County, ME.

**Counties:** Suffolk County, MA; Middlesex County, MA; Norfolk County, MA; Essex County, MA; Plymouth County, MA; Worcester County, MA; Bristol County, MA; Barnstable County, MA; Dukes County, MA; Nantucket County, MA; Bristol County, RI; Kent County, RI; Newport County, RI; Providence County, RI; Washington County, RI; Rockingham County, NH; Strafford County, NH; Hillsborough County, NH; Merrimack County, NH; Belknap County, NH; York County, ME. Within the service area, the app tells which metro area and which of its parts a place is in by its county, or, on the water or a pier, by the nearest county. [Why these counties](../metro-areas.md#greater-boston)

## Stations without times

These operators don't publish their times in a form the app can use, so nothing is downloaded from them. The app lists their stations and piers without departures, with an **Open Website** button for the operator's own page. The sources in the last column are described under [Stations without times](../data-sources.md#stations-without-times).
